name: scope-gate-worktree-cwd-regression
title: Fix scope gate to read changed files from the story worktree cwd
description: Backfill a formal Proofbound Story for the temporary local CLI hotfix made on 2026-07-08 while Prodenovo story B-35f0 was blocked. The observed bug is that scope_contract_check and story_advance REVIEW scope gates can read changed files from metadataRoot instead of the authoritative story worktree, causing unrelated dirty files in the host project to block a clean story worktree.
source: User requested formal Proofbound Story after B-35f0 exposed the CLI bug.
